page.overview:
Who is Agade Yimari?

Agade Yimari was a member of the Janusian Faithful.

Agade Yimari travelled to Arrakis alongside other nobles including Phaedra Vye, Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Oona Byrn, Venesir Ask, Roella Ramsby, Eulalia Harthorn, Ansel Virro, Bianca Bagetti and Hesperia Farani. The group were very secretive, refusing to dine with House Atreides, attend the salons or allow anyone outside their group to dine with them.

Yimari attended a banquet alongside Harthorn, Virro, Yimari, Ramsby, Bagetti and Byrn. She requested that her placement be changed, as she was alergic to a species of planet in the flower arrangement and wished to be as far away from it as possible, which was granted by the butler Theophilus. The attendants all drank poisoned wine and their the masks were also poisoned and sealed to their faces, killing them. The scene was later investigated by Dhood Shazz and the Prisoner.
